description: TASK-F09 corpus balance and live Jev re-score (ADR 0009 Verification, FR-02 band evidence). The golden corpus gained benign cases for every previously malicious-only tool and malicious cases for all tools with a defensible attack for their current behavior; three benign-only tools (agent_cache_get, agent_release_resource, agent_state_save) were left out of scored malicious evidence rather than mislabeling harmless input as an attack. Two fresh runs of scripts/jev_triage_eval.py requested jev-1.14.0 by name (served_model field), 197 cases each, 0 errors/fallbacks. No project id, TypeSafe key or credential is recorded in these files.

reference_runs.description: Committed class-blind runs on the original unbalanced corpus (68 benign / 59 malicious / 30 evasion / 10 proof, 167 cases). Kept as the BEFORE arm; not replaced.

tool_tell.method: From the scored rows: a tool is exclusive if it appears in only one ground-truth class; tool-name-only majority accuracy is the fraction of cases correctly labeled by predicting each tool's majority class.

gates.method: Repo methodology (tests/unit/test_jev_class_blind_runs_data.py): band 0.35/0.75; decided accuracy (tp+tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn); escalation = in-band fraction; AUROC pairwise; ECE 10-bin mean-p vs mean-label.

matched_comparison.method: Filter each AFTER run to the 167 case ids of the BEFORE runs before comparing accuracy. The full-corpus accuracy drop is driven by newly added, harder cases and is NOT evidence that Jev exploited the tool-name tell.

finding: Hypothesis validated on the tell metrics: class-exclusive tool names fell 33->3 (malicious-only 7->0, benign-only 26->3) on the same 37 names, and tool-name-only majority accuracy fell 0.7904->0.6701. The three remaining benign-only tools have no defensible attack for their current behavior and are excluded from scored malicious evidence. Accuracy on the MATCHED original 167 cases is flat (0.828 -> 0.828/0.8269), so the lower full-corpus accuracy (0.828 -> 0.7946/0.7935) is not evidence that the old corpus inflated accuracy; it reflects the newly added harder cases. The accuracy (>=0.98) and ECE (<=0.10) gates still fail (ECE ~0.217); escalation ~6-6.6%. Decision informed: F10's band calibration should use the balanced corpus, and the original runs remain valid evidence for the original 167 cases. No band or production change was made here.
